text:
The SO-101 Robot Arm is an open-source project for learning AI-driven robotics and manipulation tasks.
One of our members started by ordering the motors and printing the model and soon other members followed to build their own. The first robot arm is already being tuned with trained data to pick up cubes automatically, though there are still some issues to solve. 
Our robots and drones meetup works on projects like this regularly. Check munichmakerlab.de/events for dates.

text: One of our members built a nice miniature TV for theatre.
html: One of our members built a nice miniature TV for theatre.

text:
One of our members built a nice miniature TV for theatre.
For a small film set, they created a tiny television to play back clips during the show. It uses a Wemos D1 Mini (ESP8266) and a 1.44" TFT display. The 3D-printed enclosure was designed in Blender. The device is controlled via OSC (UDP) and can play back small MJPG clips, still slideshows and some test patterns.
Check out the project on GitHub: https://github.com/sonarkon/HOPE-TV

text:
One of our members is turning a Mini 4WD car into a track analyser. A sensor and battery mounted in the car's body record movement data during a run, helping him compare chassis setups and tune the car for the track.
The latest version sends live data over Bluetooth. In the video, you can see the car move and watch the sensor readings come in.#mini4wd #sensors #vehicledata #hackerspace #makerspace #openworkshop #MunichMakerLab #MuMaLab #Kreativquartier #Kreativlabor #DIYMunich

text:
One of our member build a small turret orchestra inspired by Portal 2.
Each turret is driven by a solenoid switched through a solid state relay. Conductive copper strips and 3D printed spring contacts make the units hot-swappable, while a Pi plays a MIDI file and the original audio at the same time, triggering each turret based on its assigned note.
#hackerspace #makerspace #openworkshop #MunichMakerLab #MuMaLab #Kreativquartier #Kreativlabor #DIYMunich #portal2 #midi #raspberrypi

One of our members built a 3D printed Battle/Death Racer. If you haven't heard of them: Death Racers are small motorized vehicles where the goal is to knock the hat off the other rider's figure. The more racers, the better the duels.
Now he just needs a few more makers to build their own so the battles can finally begin.
